If a city wants federal money, it should first agree to protect the people paying the bill.

We introduced the No Bailouts for Cashless Bail Jurisdictions Act to cut federal funding to any jurisdiction substantially eliminating cash bail for serious offenses and putting dangerous criminals back on the streets.

Cashless bail is not compassion. It's a revolving door, and law-abiding Americans are the ones getting hurt.

This bill is simple: eliminate cash bail, lose federal funding.

Lowcountry restaurants shouldn’t have to compete against bots for control of their own tables.

We introduced the SEAT Act to stop shady third-party platforms from listing and reselling restaurant reservations without permission. These services profit while local restaurants deal with no-shows, lost revenue, and zero accountability.

The SEAT Act puts control back where it belongs: with the restaurants.
